title: goal_questions keeps a numbered piece's lead-in that starts with a question word but asks nothing
goal: goal_questions drops a numbered piece's text before its colon when that text is a lead-in that asks nothing (no question mark and no auxiliary after its question word, as in '(1) How to proceed: does git record a change?'), and keeps it when it is the question itself, as BG-lgzf4rw7 made it. Found by the SP-4cc36epy review (S4, BG-lgzf4rw7 gate g1).

run:
import sys;sys.path.insert(0,'_tools');import bl_land as b
q=b.goal_questions('(1) How to proceed: does git record a change? (2) What token cost does coordination add: agent teams and subagent briefs?')
print(q);sys.exit(0 if q and q[0].startswith('does git') and q[1].startswith('What token cost') else 1)
